tasks.short: Create or revise instructions and manuals

steps.what: Revise user instructions, procedures, or manuals
Review the instructions and manuals before publication
Publish the accepted instructions and manuals

tasks.design: The specialist creates or revises user instructions, procedures, or manuals. The writing and the revision stay at full effort. {DOCS} does not generate the text. It publishes only the version the specialist has accepted. A blank step in the procedure stays blank and stops publication.
tasks.previous_blocker: The specialist wrote the instructions and published them by hand.
tasks.enabler_now: An accepted text can be published. The instructions stay the specialist's.
tasks.still_hard: Writing and revising the instructions stay with the specialist.
tasks.human_edge: The specialist refuses a manual that skips a blank step.
tasks.altitude: The instructions are published only after the specialist accepts that version. The text is not generated.

reach.task: Use the published instructions with a user

evidence.claim: An accepted instruction text can be published. Writing and revising it stay manual.

assumptions: The work starts with a procedure to explain and ends when the accepted text is published, or the specialist stops.
The text has a title and the steps the specialist wrote. A blank step is left blank and is not invented.
Publication uses the text accepted in the review.
unknowns: Which procedures must have a manual before users are asked to follow them.
research_questions: How often did a blank step stop publication?

already_counted.description: Creating the instructions is already in the specialist's step.

incremental.description: Correct a step before the text is accepted.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: steps are often blank, so the specialist still writes the instructions. High: the text is complete, the specialist reviews it, and only the accepted instructions are published. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Keep the existing monthly schedule running
Assemble the monthly network reports from stored counters
Publish the accepted monthly network reports

tasks.design: The specialist runs monthly network reports. The schedule in {DATA_PLATFORM} already fires, and that runtime is not the specialist's time. The report is assembled from stored counters only. A blank counter stays blank and is not treated as zero, and it stops the draft. The specialist reviews the report. Only the accepted report is published.
tasks.previous_blocker: The specialist built the monthly report from counters and published it.
tasks.enabler_now: Stored counters can be assembled into a draft. The schedule already fires. The specialist still reviews the report.
tasks.still_hard: Judging whether the monthly report is fit to publish stays with the specialist.
tasks.human_edge: The specialist refuses a report that treats a blank counter as zero.
tasks.altitude: The report is published only after the specialist accepts that version. The schedule's runtime is not new labour.

evidence.claim: Stored counters can be assembled into a monthly network report. The specialist reviews it before publication.

assumptions: The work starts with a month and ends when the accepted report is published, or the specialist stops.

A counter row has counter identifier, month, and value, already collected by the equipment. That collection, and the schedule, are not the specialist's time. A blank value is left blank and is not treated as zero.
Publication uses the report accepted in the review.
unknowns: Which counters every monthly report must include.
research_questions: How often did a blank counter stop the draft?

already_counted.description: Reviewing the monthly network reports is already in the specialist's step.

incremental.description: Correct a counter identifier before the report is accepted.

approvals.approved_version: monthly network report the specialist accepted

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: counters are often blank, so the specialist still builds the report. High: counters are complete, the specialist reviews, and only the accepted report is published. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The specialist still decides access, diagnoses a fault, and signs a change. A permission list, report, or document is written or published only after the specialist accepts that version.
reach: An operations lead receives only a network report the specialist has accepted.
A service desk colleague receives only a request record the specialist has accepted.
skills_to_grow: Stop when a required counter, field, or resolution is blank.
Accept or refuse the exact version before a write or a publication.
Keep diagnosis, access decisions, and physical work in their own hands.
role.ambitious_version: Every monthly network report traces to a stored counter, and the specialist still signs the exception.
